description: This file defines an interface for configuration properties related to JavaScript message mapping within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity mapping service. It includes default methods to access specific configuration properties and a nested builder interface to facilitate configuration setup.

classes.name: JavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration
classes.description: Interface defining configuration properties for JavaScript message mapping, including scripts and library load flags.

classes.name: JavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration.Builder
classes.description: Nested builder interface for configuring instances of JavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration.

methods.name: getIncomingScript
methods.description: Returns an optional containing the incoming message mapping script, if configured.

methods.name: getOutgoingScript
methods.description: Returns an optional containing the outgoing message mapping script, if configured.

methods.name: isLoadBytebufferJS
methods.description: Indicates whether the bytebuffer.js library should be loaded.

methods.name: isLoadLongJS
methods.description: Indicates whether the long.js library should be loaded.
